entity_schema.description: Server-owned daily AI generation usage. User profile counters are mirrors only and are never authoritative.
entity_schema.name: AiGenerationUsage

generations_used.description: Number of server-reserved AI generation slots for this UTC day.

last_generated_at.description: Timestamp of the latest reserved generation slot.

quota_key.description: Stable UTC-day key built from Base44 user id and YYYY-MM-DD.

usage_date.description: UTC calendar date for this usage bucket.

user_id.description: Authenticated Base44 user id that owns this usage bucket.

entity_schema.description: Server-owned AI word-pack cache. Each row is one reusable variant for an exact normalized theme/language/prompt-version key; raw themes are never stored.
entity_schema.name: AiWordPackCacheVariant

cache_key.description: One-way exact-match key for normalized theme, language, and prompt version.

category.description: Safe display category returned with this variant.

exclusion_key.description: One-way exact identifier for the exclusion set used to interpret an exhausted partial; raw exclusions are never stored.

exhausted.description: True when the provider could not safely produce more real words for this result; callers should not attempt a futile refill.

expires_at.description: Hard TTL boundary. Reads ignore this row at or after the timestamp.

generated_at.description: When the provider result was generated.

theme_key.description: One-way theme identifier suitable for telemetry; never a raw theme.

user_id.description: Authenticated Base44 user id that exclusively owns this cache variant.

variant_key.description: Content-derived identifier. Distinct generated packs remain separate variants under the same cache key.

word_count.description: Number of unique words stored in this variant.

words.description: Unique generated words. Exclusions are applied again when this variant is read.

entity_schema.description: Server-owned successful AI word-pack result for idempotent replay. The request key is scoped to authenticated user plus request_id; no raw theme is stored.
entity_schema.name: AiWordPackRequestResult

cache_variant_key.description: Optional cache variant that supplied or received this result.

completed_at.description: When the successful result became replayable.

exhausted.description: Exact exhaustion signal replayed with the successful result.

expires_at.description: Idempotency retention boundary. Expired rows no longer replay or conflict.

request_fingerprint.description: One-way fingerprint of cache key, requested count, and sorted normalized exclusions.

request_id.description: Client-supplied opaque request id after compatibility normalization and trim.

request_key.description: One-way key derived only from authenticated user id and normalized request_id.

result_category.description: Successful category returned for every replay of this request.

result_words.description: Successful word list returned for every replay of this request.

user_id.description: Authenticated Base44 user id owning this idempotency key.

entity_schema.description: Server-owned binding between a SpyClash account and the stable Apple appAccountToken used for StoreKit purchases.
entity_schema.name: AppStoreAccount

app_account_token.description: Stable UUID passed to StoreKit and returned in Apple transaction and renewal JWS payloads.

created_at.description: Time the billing identity was reserved for this account.

last_used_at.description: Most recent purchase preparation or verified transaction sync.

reservation_state.description: Internal two-phase reservation state. Pending rows are tombstone-owned until prepare safely claims them.

user_id.description: Authenticated Base44 user that owns this Apple billing identity.

entity_schema.description: Server-owned encrypted Sign in with Apple refresh credentials used only for account-deletion revocation.
entity_schema.name: AppleSignInCredential

binding_ticket_expires_at.description: Expiry for the idempotent post-authentication binding ticket.

binding_ticket_hash.description: One-way hash of a short-lived idempotent ticket used to bind this credential after Base44 authentication.

client_id.description: Exact native App ID or web Services ID used to mint and revoke the credential.

credential_kind.description: Identifies this server-owned row as an encrypted provider credential.

identity_key.description: Keyed one-way identifier derived from Apple's verified email claim.

manual_revocation_required.description: Deletion receipt indicating that Apple must be disconnected manually because no usable token was available.

refresh_token_ciphertext.description: AES-GCM encrypted Apple refresh token; cleared immediately after successful revocation.

refresh_token_iv.description: AES-GCM nonce bound to identity, subject, and client id.

revision.description: Opaque optimistic-concurrency revision used for exact service-role updates.

state.description: Two-phase ownership and retry-safe revocation state.

subject_key.description: Keyed one-way identifier derived from Apple's verified subject claim.

user_id.description: Authenticated Base44 owner, populated only after session provisioning.

entity_schema.description: Server-only deletion and writer coordination. The subject key is a one-way hash and never stores a raw user id.
entity_schema.name: BillingIdentityLifecycle

revision.description: Opaque CAS revision changed by every lifecycle transition.

state.description: Active writer coordination or irreversible account deletion.

subject_key.description: Deterministic one-way billing lifecycle subject key.

entity_schema.description: Admin-only moderation evidence submitted through communityAction. Clients cannot read or mutate reports directly. Account deletion replaces raw account ids with stable deletion tombstones while retaining the private report and snapshot for safety, enforcement, and legal review.
entity_schema.name: CommunityReport

content_snapshot.description: Private moderation snapshot of the reported content at submission time.

entity_schema.description: Legacy server-verified billing source retained for transaction reconciliation. Clients cannot read or write these records directly.
entity_schema.name: Entitlement

app_account_token.description: Apple appAccountToken used to bind an App Store purchase to a SpyClash account.

cancel_at_period_end.description: Whether renewal is scheduled to stop after the current paid period.

environment.description: Provider environment in which the purchase was verified.

expires_at.description: End of the currently verified entitlement period.

last_verified_at.description: Timestamp of the latest successful server-side provider verification.

price_id.description: Stripe price identifier when provider is Stripe.

provider.description: Payment provider that issued this entitlement.

provider_customer_id.description: Stripe customer identifier or another provider-side account reference.

provider_event_at.description: Provider-signed event timestamp used to reject delayed out-of-order lifecycle updates.

provider_event_id.description: Latest provider event identifier, such as an App Store notification UUID.

source_key.description: Stable provider-scoped key, for example apple:<original_transaction_id> or stripe:<subscription_id>.

status.description: Last server-verified legacy billing lifecycle status. Current feature access does not depend on this value.

stripe_dispute_blocked_charge_ids.description: Stripe charge ids with at least one canonical active or lost dispute. Kept independently from refund locks.

stripe_dispute_event_cursors.description: Latest deterministic Stripe event cursor per disputed charge id.

stripe_refund_blocked_charge_ids.description: Stripe charge ids with a canonically confirmed full successful refund. Kept independently from dispute locks.

stripe_refund_event_cursors.description: Latest deterministic Stripe event cursor per refund charge id.

transaction_id.description: Most recently verified Apple transaction identifier.

user_email.description: Last observed account email for support and migration auditing only; never used as the durable owner key.

user_id.description: Authenticated Base44 user id that owns this entitlement.

write_revision.description: Opaque server-only CAS revision changed by every entitlement persistence or identity transition.

entity_schema.description: Server-owned SpyClash friend relationship. Clients access it only through communityAction.
entity_schema.name: Friendship

blocked_by_id.description: User ID that created the block. Present only while status is blocked.

request_event_id.description: Opaque server event identity used to deduplicate the current pending request notification.

match_id.description: Immutable server-issued identity of one played match, independent of reusable room code.

match_type.description: Match origin. Only online matches contribute to competitive statistics.

player_user_id.description: Stable authenticated owner id for deletion and owner-scoped reads.

ranked.description: Whether this result contributes to rating and profile statistics.

entity_schema.description: Server-owned live room state. Clients read and mutate rooms only through gameRoomAction.
entity_schema.name: GameRoom

game_finished_event_id.description: Opaque server event identity for the current match terminal notification.

game_paused_at.description: Server-issued timestamp for the currently active host pause.

game_paused_total_seconds.description: Accumulated completed pause duration used by the authoritative deadline.

game_started_event_id.description: Opaque server event identity for the current match start notification.

intro_started_at.description: Server-issued timestamp anchoring the synchronized online intro.

match_id.description: Immutable server-issued identity for the current match; replaced only when a new replay starts.

participant_user_ids.description: Stable user ids mirrored from players for authenticated lookup and lifecycle coordination

players.description: Server-normalized player objects {user_id, email, name, avatar}

terminal_intent.description: Immutable CAS-claimed server decision reconciled into history and final room state.

entity_schema.description: Server-owned encrypted ActivityKit push-to-start or per-activity update token.
entity_schema.name: LiveActivityRegistration

last_revision.description: Latest room revision delivered to this activity token.

last_started_match_id.description: Legacy latest match marker retained for compatibility.

pending_force_end.description: Durable remote-end intent retained until ActivityKit accepts the terminal push or the token is revoked.

provider_match_id.description: Current server match generation bound to this per-activity token. Prevents replay data reaching a stale activity.

started_match_ids.description: Bounded match ledger preventing duplicate push-to-start activities across concurrent rooms.

entity_schema.description: Legacy admin-managed access grants retained for transition compatibility. Clients may read only grants for their own Base44 user id and cannot write them.
entity_schema.name: MembershipGrant

active.description: Whether this legacy manual grant is active.

expires_at.description: Optional expiry. Empty means active until an admin disables or deletes the grant.

user_id.description: Base44 User id associated with the legacy grant.

entity_schema.description: Server-owned localized global inbox announcement with an idempotent bounded fanout lease. The user inbox exposes the newest 500 retained global announcements independently from the personal window.
entity_schema.name: NotificationAnnouncement

entity_schema.description: Server-owned per-user inbox receipt for the exact bounded inbox window. The __all__ key is the user's mark-all-read watermark; writes are serialized and duplicate cardinality fails closed.
entity_schema.name: NotificationReadReceipt

entity_schema.description: Server-owned public comments left on SpyClash community profiles.
entity_schema.name: ProfileComment

entity_schema.description: Server-owned APNs alert registration. Raw installation identifiers are never stored and device tokens are encrypted at rest.
entity_schema.name: PushDeviceRegistration

entity_schema.description: Server-owned source-validated APNs outbox with a bounded exact worker lease.
entity_schema.name: PushNotificationEvent

delivered_token_hashes.description: Device token hashes already accepted by APNs. Successful devices are not resent on a partial retry.

entity_schema.description: Server-owned invitation from one SpyClash operative to an active online room.
entity_schema.name: RoomInvite

notification_event_id.description: Opaque server event identity used to deduplicate this invite notification.

entity_schema.description: Custom SpyClash fields on Base44's built-in User principal. Base44 owns row security and the built-in id, email, full_name, and role fields; clients may read and update only their own User row. Server-authoritative mirrors are additionally protected with field-level admin write rules.
entity_schema.name: User

ai_generations_today.description: Compatibility/display mirror of the server-owned AiGenerationUsage bucket.

avatar.description: Player-controlled avatar emoji or image URL. Public Community projections sanitize it before sharing.

display_name.description: Player-controlled display name. Public Community projections sanitize it before sharing.

last_ai_generation_date.description: Compatibility/display timestamp for the latest server-reserved AI generation.

radar_invite_policy.description: Player-controlled account preference for nearby Radar room invitations. Existing accounts may omit it so the iOS client can migrate its account-scoped local fallback before the first server write.

rating.description: Legacy server-authoritative profile rating mirror. Competitive leaderboard values are derived from GameHistory.

spy_id.description: Collision-checked public SpyClash identifier allocated by communityAction.

entity_schema.description: Server-owned personal word packs. Clients access them only through wordPackAction so ownership and content safety are enforced server-side.
entity_schema.name: WordPack

owner_email.description: Email of the user who created this pack, assigned by wordPackAction

owner_user_id.description: Stable Base44 user id assigned by wordPackAction. Legacy records may only have owner_email until rewritten.
